name: Elizur
overview: Elizur, identified as the son of Shedeur, served as the chief and captain of the tribe of Reuben during the wilderness journey of Israel. Scripture highlights his leadership role as he was entrusted with overseeing the Reubenite camp and leading their armies, as noted in Numbers 1:5, 2:10, and 10:18. Additionally, Elizur fulfilled priestly duties by presenting peace offerings on behalf of his tribe, demonstrating a responsibility not only in military leadership but also in spiritual service (Numbers 7:30, 7:35). His example reflects faithful stewardship and honored service within God's covenant community.
